content.intro: In this lesson, you will work through jquery deferred objects with a focused jQuery example. The subtopics below preserve the supplied curriculum coverage and connect the API idea to a small browser interface.
content.why_it_matters: This topic is useful because it turns purpose of $.deferred() into a repeatable implementation choice. jqXHR and Deferred APIs support callback-based orchestration. New code should understand native Promises and fetch(), using Deferreds when maintaining an existing jQuery integration.

common_mistakes: Assuming a selector matched an element without checking the collection length.
Confusing jQuery collections with native DOM elements or live properties with markup attributes.
Using .html() with untrusted data or assuming client-side validation enforces server rules.
